name: Espec Corp.
summary: Espec Corp. manufactures and sells environmental test, energy device, and semiconductor-related equipment worldwide. It operates through three segments: Equipment Business, Service Business, and Other Business. The company offers temperature and humidity chambers, rapid-rate thermal cycle chambers, thermal shock chambers, temperature chambers, and network products. It also provides secondary battery-related equipment; measurement and evaluation systems, and semiconductor-related equipment, as well as testing equipment; HALT and HASS systems, and indoor farm and growth chambers.
